# Key census: `tak-cli keys --ext fbi`

400 files, 8 section paths, 229 key paths, 0 parse errors. Section names are uppercased with digit runs shown as `#`. Keys are lowercased; **Files** counts files using the key, **Uses** counts entries (more than Files means repeated sections or duplicate keys). **Shapes** classifies values: int, decimal, ints/decimals (space-separated lists), word (one identifier-like token), text (anything else), empty. Examples are the most common values that are short numbers or identifiers; longer strings are never quoted, and identifiers are not quoted for keys that also hold free text. Section paths with more than 40 keys that each appear in only one file (keys that are data, such as sound names) fold those keys into one row.
